title: UX/UI Designer
description:
Tagus Retail Tech builds the e-commerce and loyalty platform behind several Iberian supermarket chains. We are hiring a UX/UI Designer to join our Lisbon team. This is a hybrid role: we work from our Alcântara office on Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays.

What you'll do:
- Design new features for our loyalty app and web shop, from flows to final UI
- Run usability tests with shoppers and store staff
- Contribute to and extend our Figma component library
- Work closely with product owners and front-end developers

What we're looking for:
- 3+ years designing digital products
- Strong Figma skills and a portfolio showing end-to-end work
- Experience with user research and usability testing
- Portuguese and English

Private health insurance, meal allowance and a yearly learning budget.

title: Interior Designer (Residential)
description:
Casa Alfama Interiores is a boutique interior design studio working on residential renovations across Lisbon and the Algarve. We are looking for an Interior Designer to join our team of six.

Responsibilities include developing concept boards and material palettes, producing technical drawings in AutoCAD and 3D visualisations in SketchUp, selecting furniture, lighting and finishes, and coordinating with contractors on site. You will meet clients at our studio and visit projects several times a week.

Requirements: degree in Interior Design or Architecture, 3+ years of residential project experience, AutoCAD and SketchUp, driving licence. Portuguese essential.

title: Product Designer
description:
Brightloop Health helps independent clinics manage scheduling, intake and billing. We're a remote-first team of 70 and we're hiring a Product Designer to own the patient-facing booking experience.

You'll partner with a PM and four engineers to discover problems, prototype solutions in Figma, test them with patients and front-desk staff, and ship. You'll also contribute to our design system.

We're looking for 3-5 years of product design experience, a portfolio of shipped work, comfort with user research, and strong communication skills.

Because of payroll, benefits and HIPAA training requirements, this role is open only to candidates residing in the United States. We are unable to hire outside the US.

title: Product Designer (Design Systems)
description:
About Nordlys
Nordlys makes invoicing and expense software for small businesses in 14 European countries. We are fully remote across Europe.

The role
We're looking for a mid-level Product Designer to look after our design system and design features for our web and mobile apps. Around half your time goes into the system (components, tokens, documentation) and half into product work with one of our squads.

You'll

  • Maintain and evolve our Figma library and design tokens
  • Work with front-end engineers to keep Figma and Storybook in sync
  • Design and test new features end to end
  • Champion accessibility (WCAG AA)

You have

  • 3-5 years of product or UX/UI design experience
  • Hands-on experience building or maintaining a design system
  • Advanced Figma (variants, auto layout, variables)
  • Experience running usability tests
  • Fluent English

Remote anywhere in Europe, 30 days holiday, home office budget.

title: Head of Design
description:
Vantage Ledger is a Series C treasury management platform used by 900 finance teams. We're looking for a Head of Design to lead our design organisation of 22 product designers, researchers and content designers across five product lines.

You will set design strategy and vision, report to the CPO, hire and develop design managers, own the design budget, and represent design at board level.

Requirements:
- 12+ years in product design, with at least 5 years managing managers
- Track record of scaling design teams of 15+ people
- Experience shaping product strategy at executive level
- Remote within European time zones

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
Fjord Mobility builds booking and fleet software for car-sharing operators in eight European countries. We're a remote team and we're hiring a UX/UI Designer for our rider app.

You'll design flows for booking, unlocking and paying for vehicles, run usability tests with riders, and maintain our Figma component library together with two other designers.

We're looking for:
- 3-5 years of UX/UI design for web or mobile products
- Strong Figma skills and a portfolio
- Experience with user research and usability testing
- Good written and spoken English

Remote within Europe. Flexible hours and a yearly team retreat.

title: UX/UI Designer Intern (Unpaid, 3 months)
description: Lumina Startups Hub is looking for a UX/UI Designer intern to support our early-stage startups for 3 months. This is an unpaid internship intended for students in their final year or recent graduates who want their first hands-on experience. You'll help with wireframes, icons and social media graphics under the guidance of a mentor. A certificate of completion is provided. Must be currently enrolled at a university or graduated within the last 12 months. No prior professional experience required.

title: UX Designer
description:
Kesselberg builds digital insurance products for German-speaking customers. Our UX team designs the self-service portal and app used by 1.2 million policyholders.

As UX Designer you will run interviews and usability tests with customers, design flows for claims and contract changes, and write and test interface copy together with our content team.

Must have:
- 3+ years of UX design experience
- Figma and prototyping
- Native or C2-level German: all research sessions, workshops and interface copy are in German
- Experience with regulated industries is a plus

Remote anywhere in the EU with two team weeks per year in Munich.

title: Product Designer
description:
At Coralpay we believe that sending money between countries should be as simple as sending a message. Since 2019 we have helped more than two million migrants and small businesses move money across Europe, Africa and Latin America at a fair price, and in 2025 we became a licensed e-money institution. We are a team of 180 people from 31 nationalities, fully remote, and we care a lot about how we work together: written-first communication, no meetings on Fridays, and a strong culture of feedback. Every year we fly the whole company to a different city for a week of workshops, hackathons and fun. Our benefits include a generous home-office budget, 28 days of holiday plus local public holidays, a learning budget of €1,500, mental health support, and equity for every employee. We are proud of our diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds to apply.

The role
You will join the Onboarding squad as a Product Designer and own the experience from download to first transfer, including identity verification. You'll work with a product manager, a researcher and six engineers.

What we're looking for
- 3-5 years of product design experience on consumer web or mobile apps
- A portfolio that shows research-led work and polished UI
- Advanced Figma and comfort working within a design system
- Experience planning and running usability tests
- Fintech or regulated onboarding (KYC) experience is a strong plus
- Fluent English

Remote from anywhere in Europe.

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
Spreewerk Labs develops booking software for fitness studios. We're looking for a UX/UI Designer to join our product team on-site in our Berlin Kreuzberg office (5 days per week, no remote option).

  • Design web and mobile features end to end
  • Conduct user interviews and usability tests with studio owners
  • Maintain our design system in Figma

You bring 3+ years of UX/UI experience, solid Figma skills and good English. German is a plus but not required.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Halcyon Analytics builds dashboards and reporting tools for e-commerce brands.

We're hiring a Senior Product Designer to lead design for our reporting product. You'll set direction for the area, mentor a mid-level designer, and partner with product leadership on the roadmap.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of product design experience, including complex B2B or data-heavy products
  • Experience mentoring other designers
  • Strong Figma, prototyping and research skills
  • Excellent English

Fully remote in Europe.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Node.js)
description:
Pipewise is building workflow automation for logistics companies. We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to design and build scalable APIs and event-driven services.

You will own services written in Node.js and TypeScript, work with PostgreSQL and Kafka, and help us improve observability and reliability.

Requirements: 5+ years of backend development, strong Node.js/TypeScript, experience with distributed systems, cloud infrastructure (AWS), and CI/CD. Fully remote, worldwide.

title: Digital Experience Specialist
description:
Atlântico Seguros Digital is the digital arm of a Portuguese insurance group. We are looking for a Digital Experience Specialist to design the customer journeys in our website and mobile app.

You will:
- Map customer journeys and run interviews and usability tests with policyholders
- Design wireframes, prototypes and high-fidelity screens in Figma
- Use and extend our component library and design tokens
- Make sure our interfaces meet WCAG 2.1 AA
- Work with product owners and front-end developers on delivery

You have 3-5 years of experience designing interfaces for web and mobile products, strong Figma skills, experience with user research, and fluent Portuguese and English.

The role is 100% remote within Portugal, with an optional monthly team day in Lisbon.

title: Talent Partner - Product Designer & UX Designer Hiring
description:
Peoplebridge Recruitment is growing its tech practice and needs a Talent Partner to recruit Product Designers and UX Designers for our clients across Europe.

You'll source candidates on LinkedIn and portfolio sites, run screening calls, manage interview processes and negotiate offers. Targets and commission apply.

What you need: 2+ years in agency or in-house recruitment, ideally tech recruitment; strong communication skills; English and Portuguese. Design knowledge is a bonus but you will not be designing.

title: UX Designer
description:
Harrowgate Learning makes revision apps used by secondary school students across the UK. We're looking for a UX Designer to join our remote product team.

You'll research how students and teachers use our apps, design new learning flows in Figma, and test them in schools.

You'll need 3+ years of UX design experience, a portfolio with research-led work, and strong Figma skills.

Please note: you must already have the right to work in the UK and be based in the UK. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship.

title: VP of Product Design
description: Orbis Commerce Group is looking for a VP of Product Design to lead a design organisation of 40 across our marketplace brands. You will report to the Chief Product Officer, set the multi-year design vision, manage four Directors of Design, and own design operations, hiring plans and budget. We expect 15+ years of experience in product design including 7+ years leading large, multi-disciplinary design organisations, and experience presenting to the executive board and investors.

title: UX/UI Designer (Remote)
description:
Sardinha Labs is a Porto-based product studio building a booking platform for independent restaurants in Portugal and Spain. The team is fully remote.

We're hiring a UX/UI Designer to work across our restaurant dashboard and diner-facing booking flows.

• Discovery interviews with restaurant owners and diners
• Wireframes, prototypes and final UI in Figma
• Keep our component library tidy and documented
• Usability testing before each major release
• Close collaboration with our 5 developers

Requirements: 3+ years as a UX/UI or product designer, solid Figma, experience with user research and usability testing, Portuguese and English.
Nice to have: basic HTML/CSS, Hotjar or Maze.

title: UX Researcher
description:
Meridian builds apps that help people manage chronic conditions. We're hiring a UX Researcher to plan and run our research programme.

You'll design and run interviews, diary studies, surveys and usability tests, synthesise findings and share them with product teams. You won't be designing UI; our product designers will rely on your insights.

We're looking for 3+ years of UX research experience, solid qualitative methods, some quantitative skills (survey design, basic statistics), and great storytelling. Remote across Europe.

title: Product Designer, 3D & Motion
description:
Polyform Studio makes an AR app for furniture retailers that lets shoppers place 3D products in their homes.

As a Product Designer, 3D & Motion, you'll design the in-app experience and create 3D scenes, product animations and motion prototypes.

Required

  • Expert-level 3D modelling and rendering in Blender or Cinema 4D (please include 3D work in your portfolio)
  • Strong motion design skills in After Effects
  • Experience with real-time 3D (Unity or Three.js)
  • 3+ years of product design

Remote worldwide.

title: Product Designer
description:
Quillstack is a document collaboration tool for legal teams.

We're hiring a Product Designer to own the editor and commenting experience. You'll research how lawyers work, prototype in Figma, test with customers, and work with our design system.

  • 3-5 years of product design experience
  • Strong interaction design and Figma skills
  • Experience with usability testing
  • Fluent English

Remote, worldwide, async-friendly.

title: Fashion Designer - Knitwear
description:
Linho & Lã is a knitwear manufacturer producing for European fashion brands. We are looking for a Fashion Designer specialised in knitwear to develop seasonal collections.

Tasks: trend research, sketching and technical packs, yarn and stitch selection, working with our sampling room and attending fittings. Requirements: degree in Fashion Design, 3+ years in knitwear, Adobe Illustrator, knowledge of Shima Seiki or Stoll programming is valued. On-site at our factory in Guimarães.

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
Tropicana Payments offers payment links and POS software for small merchants across Latin America. We're hiring a UX/UI Designer for our merchant app.

You'll design flows for payments, payouts and reporting, run usability tests with merchants, and contribute to our Figma design system.

Requirements: 3+ years of UX/UI design, strong Figma, research experience, English and Spanish or Portuguese.

Location: remote, but you must live in North or South America and work in time zones between UTC-8 and UTC-3. Candidates outside the Americas will not be considered.

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
Who we are

Lumen Care is on a mission to make home care for older adults safer, kinder and easier to coordinate. Families, carers and nurses use our apps every day to share visit notes, medication schedules and updates. We started in 2020 as three friends who had all struggled to organise care for their grandparents, and today we are a team of 95 working from 20 countries. We are fully remote and async-first, with a handful of overlap hours each day.

Why people stay

We offer a competitive salary with equity, a yearly learning budget, a home-office stipend, flexible working hours, generous parental leave, and a company-wide week off every December. We meet in person once a year. We believe care work is undervalued and we try to build a company that reflects the values of the people we serve: patience, respect and honesty.

The role

You'll join the Family App squad as a UX/UI Designer, designing features that help families coordinate care.

  • 3+ years of experience as a UX/UI or product designer
  • Strong Figma skills and experience contributing to a design system
  • Hands-on user research and usability testing
  • Accessibility knowledge (many of our users are older adults)
  • Fluent English

Remote, worldwide.

title: Product Designer - Furniture & Industrial Products
description:
Madeira Nova Móveis designs and manufactures contemporary furniture for export.

We are looking for a Product Designer (industrial design) to create new furniture lines:

  • Concept sketches and 3D CAD models in SolidWorks or Rhino
  • Technical drawings for production
  • Material and finish selection with our factory
  • Prototyping in our workshop

Degree in Industrial or Product Design, 3+ years in furniture, SolidWorks/Rhino required. On-site.

title: Web Designer (Webflow)
description:
Brightside is a remote marketing agency for B2B SaaS companies. We're hiring a Web Designer to design and build marketing websites and landing pages in Webflow.

You'll design pages in Figma, build them in Webflow, and optimise them for conversion together with our copywriters and SEO team.

Must have: 3+ years designing marketing websites, strong visual design and typography, Figma. Webflow experience preferred (we can train the right person). Remote worldwide.

title: Product Designer
description:
Élan Mutuelle Digitale is the digital team of a French health mutual insurer. We design the member app and online space for 800,000 members in France.

As Product Designer you will lead interviews and tests with members, design new journeys in Figma and work with our developers in Lyon.

Profile:
- 3 to 5 years in product or UX/UI design
- Excellent Figma skills
- Fluent French (C1 minimum) is mandatory: all user research, documentation and team communication is in French
- Remote from any EU country, with one trip to Lyon per quarter

title: Product Designer
description:
Grachten Mobility builds a bike-leasing subscription app. We're hiring a Product Designer for our Amsterdam team.

This is a hybrid role: 3 days per week in our Amsterdam office is required. We don't hire fully remote for this position.

You'll own the subscription and repair-booking flows, run usability tests and work within our design system in Figma. We're looking for 3-5 years of product design experience and fluent English.

title: Product Designer
description:
Tidewater makes scheduling software for cleaning and maintenance businesses. We're a remote team of 40.

We're hiring a mid-level Product Designer to work on our mobile app for field workers and our web dashboard for managers.

You will:
- Talk to customers and run usability tests
- Design flows and UI in Figma, using our design system
- Work closely with your PM and engineers from idea to release

You have 3-5 years of experience designing web and mobile products, good research habits, and clear written English. Remote worldwide.

title: Principal Product Designer
description:
Arcturus Cloud provides infrastructure monitoring for enterprises.

We're looking for a Principal Product Designer to shape design direction across our platform, set standards for the whole design team and influence company strategy.

  • 10+ years of product design experience, including complex enterprise products
  • Proven track record setting design direction across multiple teams
  • Experience mentoring senior designers

Remote in Europe.

title: Product Designer
description:
Belém Travel Tech builds hotel booking and channel management software for 3,000 independent hotels. We're hiring a Product Designer to join our product team in our Lisbon office (on-site, Monday to Friday).

Responsibilities:
- Design features for our hotel dashboard and booking engine
- Interview hotel owners and test prototypes with them
- Contribute to our Figma design system

Requirements: 3+ years of product design experience, strong Figma, research experience, Portuguese and English. Travel or SaaS experience is a plus.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
Tejo Precision Components manufactures metal parts for the automotive industry. We're hiring a Mechanical Design Engineer to design tooling and fixtures.

You will create 3D models and drawings in CATIA, perform tolerance analysis, and support production. Requirements: degree in Mechanical Engineering, 3+ years in automotive, CATIA V5, GD&T. On-site in Setúbal.

title: Interaction Specialist, Web App
description:
Greenleaf builds software that helps households and small businesses track and reduce their energy use. We're a remote team across Europe.

We're hiring an Interaction Specialist to shape our customer web app. In practice you'll be the designer for the app: you'll run interviews and usability tests, map journeys, create wireframes and high-fidelity screens in Figma, and maintain our component library with the front-end team.

What we're looking for:
- 3-5 years designing digital product interfaces
- Strong Figma and prototyping skills
- Experience with design systems and accessibility
- Experience with user research
- Fluent English

Remote anywhere in Europe.

title: UX Designer
description:
Redwood Civic Digital designs online services for US state and local governments. We're hiring a UX Designer to work on benefits applications.

You'll run research with residents, design accessible forms and flows in Figma, and work with developers to deliver them. We're looking for 3+ years of UX design experience and strong accessibility knowledge (WCAG 2.1 AA).

Because of our government contracts, candidates must be US citizens or permanent residents currently authorised to work in the United States. We do not sponsor visas.

title: Design Engineer (UI)
description:
Kitebase builds a developer tools platform. We're hiring a Design Engineer who both designs and ships UI.

About 70% of your time will be spent writing production front-end code. You'll build components in React and TypeScript, own our component library in code, and implement animations and interactions yourself.

Required: 3+ years of professional front-end development with React and TypeScript, strong CSS, testing experience, and a good eye for design. Figma skills are a plus. Remote in Europe.

title: UX Designer (Remote)
description:
Ribeira Health builds a teleconsultation platform used by clinics in Portugal. We're looking for a UX Designer to work on our patient app and clinician web portal.

You'll run interviews and usability tests with patients and doctors, design flows and screens in Figma, and keep our component library consistent.

Requirements: 3-5 years of UX design, solid Figma, user research experience, Portuguese and English. Accessibility experience is valued. 100% remote within Portugal.

title: Service Designer
description:
Civitas Public Lab helps European cities redesign public services.

As a Service Designer you'll map end-to-end services across digital and offline channels, run co-design workshops with residents and staff, and create service blueprints and journey maps. Digital interface design is a small part of the role.

  • 3+ years in service design, UX or a related field
  • Strong facilitation and research skills
  • Experience with journey mapping and service blueprints
  • Fluent English

Remote within Europe, occasional travel.

title: UX/UI Designer Career Advisor (Bootcamp Sales)
description:
Nova Skills Academy runs online bootcamps in UX/UI design and web development. We're hiring Career Advisors to guide prospective students and enrol them in our UX/UI Designer programme.

You'll handle inbound leads, run calls with prospective students, explain the curriculum and financing options, and hit monthly enrolment targets. Experience in sales or customer success required; interest in design is a plus. Portuguese and English.

title: UX Designer
description:
Bluefin builds a freight booking platform for shippers and carriers across Europe. We're looking for a UX Designer to join our product team.

Responsibilities
- Lead research with shippers and carriers (interviews, usability tests)
- Design flows and interfaces for our web platform in Figma
- Contribute to our design system and improve accessibility
- Partner with PMs and engineers in a cross-functional squad

Requirements
- 3-5 years of UX or product design experience
- Strong Figma skills
- Experience with B2B or complex web applications is a plus
- Fluent English
- EU work authorisation required (we hire as employees in EU countries via our employer of record; no visa sponsorship)

Remote within the EU.

title: Product Designer
description:
Maplegrid makes property management software for Canadian landlords. We're hiring a Product Designer for our tenant portal.

You'll run research with tenants and landlords, design flows in Figma, and work closely with engineering. 3-5 years of product design experience required.

This is a remote role open only to residents of Canada. You must live in Canada at the time of hire.

title: Design Director, Digital Products
description:
Estrela Bank is looking for a Design Director to lead all digital product design for our retail and business banking apps. You will manage three design managers and a team of 25 designers and researchers, define the design vision with the executive committee, and own design hiring and budget.

Requirements: 12+ years in digital product design, at least 6 years leading design teams of 15+, experience in banking or fintech, excellent Portuguese and English. Remote within Portugal with monthly leadership meetings in Lisbon.

title: Product Designer, Mobile (iOS & Android)
description:
Pulsefit is a fitness coaching app with 4 million downloads. We're hiring a Product Designer focused entirely on our native mobile apps.

You'll design workouts, progress tracking and social features, prototype complex gestures and transitions, and work closely with our iOS and Android engineers.

We're looking for 3+ years of product design, with a strong portfolio of native mobile apps. Deep knowledge of Human Interface Guidelines and Material Design and experience prototyping interactions in tools like ProtoPie are strongly preferred. Remote in Europe.

title: UX Designer
description:
Brightpath Learning started with a simple idea: every adult deserves a second chance to learn. Our online platform helps more than 400,000 learners in Europe, the Middle East and Africa earn accredited qualifications while they work, care for family or change careers. We partner with 60 universities and colleges and have been a certified B Corp since 2023. Our team of 150 is remote across EMEA time zones, and we are serious about sustainable working: core hours from 10:00 to 15:00 CET, no-meeting Wednesdays, a four-day week every August, and an annual wellbeing budget. We offer a competitive salary, pension contributions where available, 30 days of holiday, a learning budget, and a paid volunteering day each quarter. We also run a mentoring programme that pairs every new joiner with a buddy from another team.

About the role
As a UX Designer in our Learner Experience team, you'll redesign how learners plan their studies and track progress.

You'll need
- 3-5 years of UX or UX/UI design experience
- A portfolio showing research, flows and UI
- Advanced Figma and experience working with a design system
- Experience running usability tests and interviews
- Fluent English

Remote across EMEA.

title: Sales Development Representative
description: Velocity CRM is hiring Sales Development Representatives for our Lisbon hub to prospect into mid-market companies in Southern Europe. You'll make outbound calls, send sequences, qualify leads and book meetings for Account Executives. Requirements: 1+ year in sales or customer-facing roles, fluent Portuguese and English, Spanish a plus. Office-based in Lisbon with uncapped commission.

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
CASTELLANA DIGITAL - UX/UI DESIGNER - MADRID

We are a digital agency working for banks and insurers in Spain. We are looking for a UX/UI Designer to join our team.

-Design web and app interfaces for clients
-User research and usability testing
-Figma, prototyping, design systems

REQUIREMENTS: 3+ years experience, Figma, Spanish and English. Work location: our office in Madrid (on-site, 5 days). No remote work possible for this position.

title: Product Designer
description:
Polderbank Digitaal designs mobile banking for Dutch and Belgian customers. We are hiring a Product Designer for our savings and investments team.

You will run interviews and tests with customers, design journeys in Figma, and write interface copy with our content designers.

Requirements:
- 3-5 years of product design experience
- Fluent Dutch (spoken and written) is required, as our customers, research sessions and all internal documentation are in Dutch
- Strong Figma and prototyping skills

Remote from the Netherlands or another EU country.

title: Product Designer, Growth
description:
We run a coffee subscription service shipping to 12 European countries, and our 8-person product team is fully remote.

We're hiring a Product Designer to join our Growth squad and improve sign-up, checkout and retention.

What you'll do
- Design and test experiments across our web shop and app
- Work with our analyst on A/B tests and interpret results
- Run quick usability tests and interviews
- Keep our UI consistent with our design system

What you'll bring
- 3-5 years in product or UX/UI design
- E-commerce or checkout experience
- Strong Figma skills
- Fluent English

Remote, working hours within CET ±2.

title: UI Designer (Visual & Brand)
description:
Stellar Games makes casual mobile puzzle games. We're hiring a UI Designer to create in-game interfaces, icons, store assets and brand materials.

Most of the role is visual: illustration-heavy UI, iconography, marketing art and brand guidelines. You'll work with game designers and artists rather than product managers, and there is little user research.

Requirements: 3+ years of UI or visual design, a strong visual portfolio, Figma and Adobe Illustrator. Game UI experience is a plus. Remote worldwide.

title: Product Designer
description:
Openhearth builds tools for housing co-operatives to manage members, maintenance and finances. We're remote across Europe.

We're hiring a Product Designer to own our member app. You'll talk to residents, design and prototype in Figma, test with users, and evolve our design system with the front-end team.

You bring 3-5 years of product design experience, good research skills, accessibility awareness, and fluent English. Remote within European time zones.
